transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi there. I'm calling because I got a flyer in the mail about upgrading my internet service. I think to fiber?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's wonderful! Upgrading to our fiber network is a great choice. I can definitely help you with that. To get started, could I have your full name, please?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure, it's Daniel Smith.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Mr. Smith. And just to pull up your account for security, could you please provide either the phone number associated with the account or your customer ID?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yep, the phone number is 555-300-2384.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you. I'm pulling up your information now... one moment... Okay, I see your account. The final step for verification is your 4-digit security PIN.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: My PIN... oh boy. Let me think. I set that up a while ago. Is it... 5019?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, that's it! Thank you for verifying your information, Mr. Smith. Your account is now securely accessed.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great, glad I remembered it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So, you mentioned seeing a flyer about our Cymbal Fiber network. I'm just confirming the availability at your service address... and yes! I'm showing your entire neighborhood is now fully enabled for fiber. We can definitely get you upgraded from your current DSL plan.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Excellent. That DSL is just not cutting it anymore, especially with me working from home. What are the options?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand. The difference is night and day. Our most popular plan, and the one most people upgrade to, is our Fiber Gigabit plan. It provides symmetrical download and upload speeds of up to 940 megabits per second.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Symmetrical? What's the benefit of that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It means your upload speed is just as fast as your download speed. With your current DSL, you might get 50 megabits for downloads, but your uploads are probably closer to 5. With fiber, uploading large work files, cloud backups, or even just having clear video calls becomes effortless.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that's a huge deal for me. My video calls are always freezing. So what's the cost for that gigabit plan?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check the current promotions for your area. Yes, for customers upgrading from DSL, the Fiber Gigabit plan is $85 per month. That's with auto-pay and paperless billing discounts applied.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Eighty-five dollars. Okay. And what am I paying now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're currently on a DSL 50 plan for $59.99 a month. So it's about a $25 increase, but for roughly twenty times the speed on downloads and almost two hundred times the speed on uploads.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wow, when you put it like that... it sounds worth it. Okay. What about other fees? Installation, equipment, all that stuff.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great question. Normally, the professional installation is $99. However, as part of the new service rollout in your area, we are waiving the installation fee completely.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Free installation, I like the sound of that. And equipment?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The new service requires new equipment. Our technician will install a device called an Optical Network Terminal, or ONT. That's what brings the fiber signal into your home. There's no charge for that device.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, an ONT. Got it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And to handle the new speeds, we also provide our latest Cymbal Wi-Fi Gateway. It's a powerful Wi-Fi 6 router designed for gigabit speeds. The rental for that is normally $10 a month, but it's already included in that $85 price I quoted.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So let me be clear, the $85 is the final price, not $85 plus another $10 for the router?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is correct. $85 per month is the total for the service and the router. The only thing on top of that would be your standard local and state taxes.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that's very straightforward. I appreciate that. No hidden fees.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We try to be as transparent as possible. We also lock in that price for two years, so you don't have to worry about any increases during that time.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: A two-year price lock is nice. Is there a contract then?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: There's no annual contract or early termination fee. The price is guaranteed for two years, but you can cancel at any time without a penalty. We're confident you'll be happy with the service.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, this all sounds really good. I'm ready to do it. Let's sign me up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fantastic choice, Mr. Smith! I'll start building the order right now. This will just take a few moments on my end. Please bear with me.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, thank you for your patience. I have the order framework ready. I am confirming the service address is 123 Main Street, correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's the one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Now, we need to schedule the technician visit. This is for the installation of the fiber line to your home and setting up the new equipment inside. An adult over 18 must be present for the duration of the visit.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay. How long does it usually take?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The appointment window is four hours, but the actual work on-site typically takes between two to three hours, depending on the complexity of running the line.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And will they have to drill holes?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: In most cases, a small hole, about the diameter of a pencil, is required to pass the fiber cable through an exterior wall. The technician will consult with you on the best and least conspicuous placement before doing any drilling.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that's fine. As long as I get to approve the spot.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. They will not proceed without your consent. Now, let's look at the schedule. I have openings this week. The earliest is this Thursday.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thursday works for me. What times are available?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We have two arrival windows: 8 AM to 12 PM, or 1 PM to 5 PM.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I have some work meetings in the morning. The afternoon window, 1 to 5 PM, would be much better.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not a problem at all. I am booking you for this Thursday, with an arrival window of 1 PM to 5 PM. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's perfect.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. The technician will call you when they are on their way to your home. Can I confirm the best contact number for the technician is the 555-300-2384 number?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's my cell. That's the best one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. I've added that to the work order notes. Now, a question about equipment placement. The ONT and the new Cymbal Wi-Fi Gateway will be installed. Where in your home would you prefer them to be?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Well, my current DSL modem is in my home office on the main floor. That's where my computer is. Can they just put the new stuff there?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The home office is a perfect location. Central placement for the router usually provides the best Wi-Fi coverage. I'll add a note for the technician to plan for an installation in the home office.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Perfect.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, the appointment is set. Now, let's briefly discuss the billing transition.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right, the pro-rated stuff you mentioned?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. Your billing cycle closes on the 25th of each month. Your installation is this Thursday, which is the 15th. So on your next bill, you will see a credit for your old DSL plan from the 15th to the 25th.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So I get money back for the ten days I'm not using it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. And then you'll see a corresponding partial charge for the new Fiber Gigabit plan for those same ten days, from the 15th to the 25th. After that, it will just be the flat $85 per month on subsequent bills. Does that make sense?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, it does. So the next bill will be a little messy, but it will even out after that. I get it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Precisely. Now, I'm just finalizing the order in the system. While it processes, I need to read you a few required disclosures. It's mostly a summary of what we've discussed. May I proceed?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure, go for it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. This is to confirm you are ordering the Cymbal Telecom Fiber Gigabit service for a promotional price of $85 per month, plus taxes, with a two-year price guarantee. This price requires enrollment in auto-pay and paperless billing.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The service provides speeds up to 940 Mbps download and 940 Mbps upload. Actual speeds may vary based on computer performance, home wiring, and other factors. Do you acknowledge this?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I understand.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you are authorizing a professional installation on the scheduled date, and agree to the terms of service which will be emailed to you. There is no annual contract or early termination fee associated with this plan. Do you agree?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I agree.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Thank you for confirming. The system is just about done... Okay! The order has been successfully submitted.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great! So I'm all set?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Almost! I have an order confirmation number for your records. Do you have a pen and paper handy?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Uh, yeah, hold on. Let me grab one... Okay, ready.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your order number is F-O-1-7-3-4-9-0-1. I'll repeat that.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wait, F as in Frank?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, F for Fiber. Then O for Order. Then the numbers are 1-7-3-4-9-0-1.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, got it. F-O-1-7-3-4-9-0-1. You'll email this to me too, right?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, a full confirmation email with the order number, appointment details, and terms of service should be in your inbox within the hour. I'm confirming your email on file is daniel.smith@telecom-personal.com.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's the one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. Just one last piece of business, Mr. Smith. What to do with your old DSL modem.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, right. I was going to ask that. Do I give it to the technician?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The technician can't take it, but we have a very simple return process. We will mail you a free return kit. It contains a box and a pre-paid UPS shipping label.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You just need to pack the DSL modem and its power cord into the box, stick the label on, and drop it at any UPS Store or official dropbox. You have 30 days from your installation date to return it.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And if I don't?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If it's not returned within that timeframe, a one-time unreturned equipment fee of $75 would be applied to your account. So it's definitely best to send it back.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Understood. I'll keep an eye out for the return box in the mail.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It should arrive at your home within 3 to 5 business days.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now, just a quick question about the new router. Do you have any specific needs, like a large home or many devices?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Uh, it's a pretty average-sized house, maybe 2000 square feet. We have a couple of laptops, a few phones, a smart TV... maybe 10-15 devices in total?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Cymbal Wi-Fi Gateway should cover that area perfectly and can handle over 75 devices simultaneously, so you'll have plenty of capacity for the future.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Seventy-five? Wow, okay. I won't be needing that many, but good to know.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's built for the modern smart home. You'll also be able to customize your Wi-Fi network name and password. The technician can help you with that, or you can do it easily through the Cymbal Telecom app afterwards.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: There's an app?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes! You can manage your Wi-Fi, run speed tests, and even pay your bill. I highly recommend downloading it once your new service is active.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, I'll look for it. 'Cymbal Telecom app'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's the one. Let me just place you on a brief hold while I add the final notes to your account and confirm the return kit has been ordered. It will be about 30 seconds.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure, no problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Mr. Smith. I've confirmed everything on my end. The return kit order is in the system, and I've added detailed notes for the installation technician about the office placement. You are all set.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Fantastic. So just to recap one last time: technician comes Thursday afternoon between 1 and 5. They'll call first. It takes 2-3 hours. They install everything, and I'll have super fast internet when they leave.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is a perfect summary. And your old DSL will keep working right up until the fiber is activated, so there's no downtime.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, that's great. I was a little worried about that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We make it a seamless cutover. The technician will make sure your main computer or phone can connect to the new 'Cymbal Wi-Fi' network and is getting the correct speeds before they consider the job complete.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: This is great. I'm actually really excited about this.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We are too! We're very proud of our fiber network, and we love hearing from customers after they experience the speed for the first time.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I bet. Well, I think that's all my questions.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. Was there anything else at all I could assist you with today, Mr. Smith? Any questions about your TV or phone service?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, I just have internet with you. And this was the only thing on my mind. You've been extremely helpful, Sarah.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It has been my absolute pleasure to help you with your upgrade today. We truly appreciate your business and are thrilled to welcome you to the Cymbal Fiber family.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thanks again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome. Thank you for choosing Cymbal Telecom, and have a fantastic rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.
